## Summary

Describe the smallest coherent change and reference its phase/task ID.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the task's acceptance command and recorded real output in `PROGRESS.md`.
- [ ] `make lint test` passes.
- [ ] I updated `TASKS.md`, documentation, decisions, and version pins where relevant.
- [ ] No secret, generated model data, state file, or credential is included.
- [ ] The commit title follows Conventional Commits.

## Risk and rollback

Describe runtime risk, affected components, and the rollback command or commit.
